description:
Search businesses

Search our company database by company name or KVK number. A local cache
(48 hours) serves repeated queries.
Results per page can be: 5, 10, 25, 50, or 75 (default 25).
KVK API caps results at 50 per request.

At least one of `naam` or `kvkNummer` is required.

Cost: 1 credit(s) per call. An API key is required via the X-Api-Key header (or Authorization: Bearer <key>); a per-call wallet payment via x402 is also accepted.
name: kvk.search
